### The NCF Christmas Party!

Saturday December 27th.

A gathering for all of the NCF gang to celebrate a good year in our space/venue.

With music from:

**Sean Gorman**: one of our Open Mic night hosts kicking things off with an acoustic set like no other.

**W.O.T? (Way Over Thinking)**: 5 piece rock band with a set full of classics we'll all know and love.

**DJ Ribbon Legs**: Stepping in for Spuggy, Ribbon Legs will close out the night dropping tunes that are guaranteed to get you on the dancefloor!

**Adm:** €10 / B.Y.O.B

Doors at 9, come early to avoid disappointment! 🥂
